title: Walkthrough data clean-up
summary: Operators can now remove walkthrough and test records from the live service safely, with an archive kept first.
changes: Add an operator command that lists walkthrough and QA test records and, when confirmed, archives them to a file before removing them.
Keep the documented walkthrough sign-in account; only its test records are removed.
Confirm that setting up the live service never creates QA test accounts or records.
version_rationale: Patch: an operator command and a test. No user-facing behaviour, routes or schema change.
validation: ArchiveQaDataCommandTest for the dry run, forced archive and removal, and the production seeding guard.
Seeder and architecture tests locally, and the full PHPUnit suite in CI.
Read-only production check before release, then a production dry run before removal.
known_limitations: Matching relies on the documented test title prefixes and QA account emails.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Removed test records can be restored from the JSON archive or the pre-deploy Cloudron backup.
